runtimeRequirements: Pi model registry with reasoning/thinkingLevelMap capability metadata
global enabledModels is enforced as a hard pre-agent allowlist, including explicit --model selections; configured empty, malformed, or unreadable policy fails closed without an LLM request

/effort reads pi.getThinkingLevel, puts the supported current level first in Pi's host selector, reports an unchanged current selection as VIEW without mutation, and sets pi.setThinkingLevel only for a different capability-validated level

the shared inline interaction slot fences Pi's own close callback by slot ownership: a component the host silently replaced can no longer run the host's editor-restore path, so a late timeout, abort, or queued key from a superseded prompt cannot blank the interaction that replaced it, and the incumbent is retired only once the newcomer's factory has produced a component, so a request that never appears cannot take the slot; when a factory rejects, Pi restores the editor over the live component anyway, so the incumbent is explicitly retired on that path too and its owner is told rather than left awaiting a surface that is off the screen; a retired caller sees the typed stale error and reports benign replacement rather than failure — /model-roles closes benignly and keeps any applied route
